service.description: Parse and type-check a decimal expression: numbers, input names, + - * /, unary minus, the comparisons < <= > >= == !=, and, or, not, parentheses and the functions if, min, max, abs, round, floor and ceil; the whole expression is an amount. With inputNames, a name outside them is refused (UNKNOWN_NAME). Answers the names it reads and the functions it calls, or the refusal with its code, message and 1-based position.

parameter.name: expression
parameter.description: Empty is refused as EXPRESSION_REQUIRED, in the out-parameters.

parameter.name: inputNames
parameter.description: The names the expression may read; when not given, any name.

parameter.name: names
parameter.description: The input names the expression reads, sorted, each once

parameter.name: functions
parameter.description: The functions it calls, sorted, each once

service.description: Evaluate a decimal expression (as validate#DecimalExpression parses it) over inputs, a map of each name to a decimal (a BigDecimal, a whole number, a script number or decimal text; anything else INPUT_INVALID). Every name it reads must have a value (else MISSING_INPUT, with missingNames), checked before evaluating. + - * are exact, / keeps the decimal type's full precision, and nothing is rounded but by round, floor and ceil.

parameter.name: expression
parameter.description: Empty is refused as EXPRESSION_REQUIRED, in the out-parameters.

parameter.name: inputNames
parameter.description: The names the expression may read; when not given, any name.
